function DistilleryScene:drawStill()
    local cx = math.floor(self.W / 2)
    local cy = math.floor(self.H * 0.65)
    if math.random(1, 3) > 1 then
        self.renderer.matrix:rect(cx-6, cy-10, 12, 2, 3)
        self.renderer.matrix:rect(cx-4, cy-9, 8, 2, 6)
    end
    if DistilleryAssets and DistilleryAssets.GetSprite then
        local sprite = DistilleryAssets.GetSprite("PotStill")
        self.renderer.matrix:drawSprite(cx - 8, cy - 8, sprite)
    else
        self.renderer.matrix:rect(cx-8, cy-8, 16, 20, 21)
    end
    self.renderer.matrix:rect(cx + 0, cy + 4, 10, 2, 20)
    self.renderer.matrix:rect(cx + 0, cy + 5, 10, 1, 12)
    self.renderer.matrix:rect(cx + 8, cy - 10, 2, 16, 20)
end

drawSprite:
function DotMatrix:drawSprite(x, y, arg3, arg4)
    local w, h, data
    
    if type(arg3) == "table" and arg3.data then
        -- New Signature
        w = arg3.w
        h = arg3.h
        data = arg3.data
    else
        -- Old Signature (Compatibility)
        w = arg3
        data = arg4
        h = math.ceil(#data / w)
    end
    
    if not data then return end
    
    -- Iterate through the 1D array
    -- Data is assumed to be row-major (top row first, left to right)
    for i = 1, #data do
        local colIdx = data[i]
        
        if colIdx > 0 then
            -- Convert 1-based index (Lua) to 0-based index
            local zeroBasedIndex = i - 1
            
            -- Calculate column (x offset)
            local col = zeroBasedIndex % w
            
            -- Calculate row (y offset from top)
            local row = math.floor(zeroBasedIndex / w)
            
            -- In Codea/DotMatrix, Y increases upwards.
            -- Sprite data usually starts at top-left (row 0).
            -- So, we draw at (baseY + (height - 1 - row)) to flip it correctly.
            if row < h then
                self:rect(x + col, y + (h - 1 - row), 1, 1, colIdx)
            end
        end
    end
end
